'''Sus'mintri''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], located on the continent of [[Alanciar]]. As of 3000 BBY, it was a major government center of Alanciar, with some activities held in the building [[Vaal Hall]].
